question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities remain a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which child items should instead move to plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The tracker spans product direction, persistent widget/workspace state, browser sandboxing, install/publish trust, and role visibility boundaries that read-only cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor Selective Slices
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review linked child issues and PRs one by one, requiring explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

options.title: Move Optional Pieces Outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or tab-app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer The Roadmap
options.body: Pause or later close the Wave 2+ tracker if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Selective Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review linked child issues and PRs one by one, requiring explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal for the current tab seam is the Logbook/plugin-tab work this roadmap extends.
